Name: Avatar Typing: Horde Invasion
Overview:
Stop an onslaught of angry Avatars by...typing? Logical enough! Can you type the sentences you're given before the enemies cross your path?

Featuring 8 enemy types and 2 modes of play, the action is sure to last. With over 1,500+ sentences to type and the ability to create your own, you're almost guaranteed to develop a fun case of carpal tunnel!

Chatpad or Keyboard required.
